marketTickers.title: Market tickers
marketTickers.description: Exact Kalshi markets, e.g. KXNFLGAME-26OCT18PITTB-TB. Leave all three ticker fields empty to scan the whole exchange for whale trades.

eventTickers.title: Event tickers
eventTickers.description: Every market in these events, e.g. KXNFLGAME-26OCT18PITTB (both teams).

seriesTickers.title: Series tickers
seriesTickers.description: Every OPEN market in these series, e.g. KXHIGHNY, KXFED. Up to 300 markets per run.

lookbackHours.title: Lookback (hours)
lookbackHours.description: How far back to read trades and candles for the tickers above. Up to 2,160 (90 days).

whaleScanMinutes.title: Whale scan window (minutes)
whaleScanMinutes.description: Used only when no tickers are given: how far back to scan the whole exchange. Kalshi prints ~6,000 fills a minute, so 30 minutes is ~180,000 fills checked.

minNotionalUsd.title: Minimum trade size (USD)
minNotionalUsd.description: Only fills where contracts x price paid is at least this. Empty = $1,000 in the whale scan, $0 for tickers.

minContracts.title: Minimum contracts
minContracts.description: Only fills of at least this many contracts.

maxTakerPrice.title: Maximum price paid
maxTakerPrice.description: Skip fills where the taker paid more than this (0.01-1). Default 0.97 drops near-certain bets at 98-99.9c on contracts about to settle, which are large but carry no signal. Set 1 to keep everything.

takerSide.title: Taker side
takerSide.description: Only fills where the taker bought this side.

includeCandles.title: Price candles
includeCandles.description: One row per candle per market: open, high, low, close, bid/ask, volume, open interest. Needs tickers.

candleInterval.title: Candle interval
candleInterval.description: 1m covers at most the last 2 days, 1h the last 60 days.

maxRows.title: Maximum rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows (trades plus candles).
